integrity: Analytic proof, explicitly defined sharp norm, and independently executable finite numerical diagnostics are included; finite checks are not substitutes for limit proofs. External independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The proof holds for fixed total polynomial degree m>=2, continuous uniform product measure, and d tending to infinity. It does not identify exact finite-dimensional maximizers, supply a finite-d formula, or handle growing m; equivalence to an unindexed older result is not excluded. The 2008 exact public date is documented by arXiv v1; an additional highly relevant 2014 article was independently dated only to month and year.
title: Hermite law and asymptotic corner rigidity for total-degree Legendre projections on cubes
